traffic.title: Packet traffic
traffic.none: No packet counters from the repeater in MeshMonitor.
traffic.needPolling: The numbers come from the repeater’s own counters. For this, MeshMonitor has to request its status regularly (enable telemetry requests for this node there). Single requests via “Request status now” only give rough values.
traffic.measured: Per hour: measured between the latest status values (over {span}).
traffic.noFresh: Per hour: no fresh measurement (last status older than 3 h or a restart).
traffic.hint: From the repeater’s own counters ({n} measurements in MeshMonitor). “Sent” includes forwarded and own packets. “≥” = restart during the period, packets before it are missing (minimum). “–” = a boundary of the period falls into a measurement gap of over 3 h.
